title: Allen Dulles CIA and Warren Commission Files
metaDescription: Allen Dulles directed the CIA from 1953 to 1961 and served on the Warren Commission. His correspondence appears in the JFK collection and State files.
h1: Allen Dulles in CIA, Warren Commission, and State files
lede: Allen Dulles directed the CIA from 1953 to 1961 and served on the Warren Commission investigating the assassination of President Kennedy. His correspondence appears across both the JFK collection and early Cold War State Department files. BlackVaultDocs’ figure hub matches the name Allen Dulles in document titles from public NARA releases. The hub is a title index, not a finding on the Commission and not a file count. PDFs remain on the originating archive.

sections.h2: What the Dulles figure hub lists
paragraphs: The figure slug allen-dulles groups indexed titles that name Allen Dulles. The packet supplies no document count, so this page does not invent one. The public-record identity in the blurb is: directed the CIA from 1953 to 1961; served on the Warren Commission investigating the assassination of President Kennedy; correspondence appears across both the JFK collection and early Cold War State Department files.

Two holding series are named for correspondence: the JFK collection, and early Cold War State Department files. The packet does not split title hits between those series. This overlay does not invent that split. A title match is a catalog hit, not a finding that the file is a Commission memorandum rather than a State cable.

1953 to 1961 is the CIA directorship window in the blurb. The packet does not give a start date for Warren Commission service. This page therefore does not invent one. It cites Commission service as the blurb cites it, alongside the assassination investigation of President Kennedy.

sections.h2: What this page does not claim
paragraphs: This overlay does not argue that Dulles’s CIA tenure or Commission service proves a conspiracy in the Kennedy assassination. It restates the packet: directed the CIA from 1953 to 1961; served on the Warren Commission investigating the assassination of President Kennedy; correspondence appears across the JFK collection and early Cold War State Department files. Conspiracy commentary is outside the index.

No NARA ID is in the facts. No document total is in the facts. Cite 1953, 1961, the Warren Commission, the JFK collection, and early Cold War State Department files. Do not attach an invented file count to Dulles’s name.

The Allen Dulles figure hub is the live title list. All figures shows the rest of the name index. The JFK assassination collection is the related topic link on this packet. Open the originating archive for scans. A later ingest can retag titles; this prose still will not invent a document count.

The JFK collection and early Cold War State Department files are two holding series for correspondence. This page does not split title hits between them. A State file that omits Dulles’s name would not be promised by this name index.
